# togetherai_gpu_cluster_regions (Data Source)

GPU cluster regions with their GPU types and NVIDIA driver versions (`GET /v1/compute/regions`). Availability changes over time. The response has no prices; see https://www.together.ai/pricing#gpu-clusters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "togetherai_gpu_cluster_regions" "all" {}

output "h100_regions" {
  value = [for r in data.togetherai_gpu_cluster_regions.all.regions : r.name if contains(r.supported_instance_types, "H100_SXM")]
}
```

## Schema

- `regions` (Attributes List) Regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Region name, for `togetherai_gpu_cluster.region`.
- `supported_instance_types` (List of String) GPU types, for `gpu_type`.

<a id="nestedatt--regions--driver_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions.driver_versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Catalog ID, for `nvidia_version_id`.
- `nvidia_driver_version` (String) NVIDIA driver version.
- `os` (String) OS image family.
